body:
When a Bittensor (finney) user signs `SubtensorModule.add_stake` for 1 TAO, the generic app shows the amount in rao, with no decimals and no unit. The review screens on a Nano S Plus (Speculos, app v100.0.29), title and value of each:

```
Chain            node-subtensor
SubtensorModule  add_stake
hotkey           5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY
netuid           1
amount_staked    1000000000
```

Flex shows the same value (`amount_staked` / `1000000000`). `Balances.transfer_keep_alive` on the same chain is formatted correctly (`value TAO 1.25` in the C++ unit tests, vector 0 of the test file in the PR), so the decimals (9) and unit (`TAO`) from the proof's `ExtraInfo` are available; the staking amount just isn't treated as a balance.

## Cause

`checkBalanceEncoding` in `app/src/metadata_parser.c` formats an unsigned or compact value only when the field's type name is in `balanceTypes` (`Balance`, `BalanceOf<T>`, `BalanceOf<T, I>`, `DepositBalance`, `ExtendedBalance`, `PalletBalanceOf<T>`, `T::Balance`).

Subtensor (Bittensor's runtime) declares TAO amounts with its own newtype, [`pub struct TaoBalance(u64)`](https://github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/blob/v477/common/src/currency.rs#L73) with a derived `TypeInfo`, and its calls take that type directly ([`add_stake`](https://github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/blob/v477/pallets/subtensor/src/macros/dispatches.rs#L559-L566)):

```rust
pub fn add_stake(origin: OriginFor<T>, hotkey: T::AccountId, netuid: NetUid, amount_staked: TaoBalance) -> DispatchResult
```

The field's type name is therefore `TaoBalance`, and the inner `u64` is printed as a plain integer. Balances calls are not affected because their fields' type name is `T::Balance`, even though the runtime's `Balance` is also `TaoBalance` ([`pub type Balance = TaoBalance`](https://github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/blob/v477/common/src/lib.rs#L32)).

In the finney metadata (spec 477; the current spec 478 has the same V15 metadata apart from the spec version), these call fields have the type name `TaoBalance`:

- TAO amounts: `amount_staked` of `add_stake`, `add_stake_limit` and `stake_into_basket`, `add_stake_burn.amount`, `swap_coldkey.swap_cost`, and the arguments of `AdminUtils.sudo_set_min_burn`, `sudo_set_max_burn`, `sudo_set_total_issuance`, `sudo_set_network_min_lock_cost` and `sudo_set_rao_recycled`.
- Prices: `limit_price` of `add_stake_limit`, `remove_stake_limit` and `add_collateral` (rao per alpha), and of `swap_stake_limit` and `move_stake_limit` (a ratio of two subnet prices, see below).

## Proposed fix

Add `"TaoBalance"` to `balanceTypes`. TAO is the chain's native token and its decimals and symbol are already in the proof, so the TAO amounts above then render like any other native balance (`amount_staked TAO 1.0`). `docs/format.md` asks chains to use one of the listed types, but `TaoBalance` is subtensor's own balance type (Balances' `T::Balance` resolves to it), so matching it in the app is the smaller change. A PR with this change, the matching line in `docs/format.md`, and test vectors follows.

The `limit_price` fields get the TAO unit too, since the app goes by the type name. For `add_stake_limit`, `remove_stake_limit` and `add_collateral` that reads correctly: `limit_price TAO 0.05` is 0.05 TAO per alpha. For `swap_stake_limit` and `move_stake_limit` it does not: there `limit_price` is the origin/destination alpha price ratio scaled by 1e9 (see the [`move_stake_limit` doc](https://github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/blob/v477/pallets/subtensor/src/macros/dispatches.rs#L1652-L1653) and [`get_max_amount_move`](https://github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/blob/v477/pallets/subtensor/src/staking/move_stake.rs#L667-L673), which both calls use; the `swap_stake_limit` doc comment still says "RAO per one Alpha"). A 0.95 ratio would show as `limit_price TAO 0.95` instead of `950000000`. The PR leaves this as is; let me know if you would rather keep those two raw.

`AlphaBalance` should not be added. It is also a `u64` newtype (used by `remove_stake`, `move_stake`, `transfer_stake`, `swap_stake` and others), but it is an amount of a subnet's alpha token, not TAO, so showing it with the TAO unit would mislabel it. It stays raw with this change. A possible follow-up is to mark it the way Assets amounts are marked today (`Raw amount_unstaked`), so the user can tell the number is unformatted.

Fields typed `Option<TaoBalance>` (`remove_stake_full_limit.limit_price`, `add_stake_burn.limit`) also stay raw after this change, as `Option<BalanceOf<T>>` fields do on other chains: the `Some` field has no type name and the outer name is `Option<TaoBalance>`.

## How this was reproduced

- App: `main` at 644ec638 (v100.0.29), built for nanosp and flex with `ghcr.io/ledgerhq/ledger-app-builder/ledger-app-builder-lite` (`make COIN=DOT PRODUCTION_BUILD=1`).
- Emulator: Speculos v0.27.1 (`ghcr.io/ledgerhq/speculos`), models nanosp and flex, seeded with the zemu test mnemonic, signing with ed25519 on `m/44'/354'/0'/0'/0'`.
- Payload and proof: built with bittensor-core from the subtensor repo at tag [`v477`](https://github.com/RaoFoundation/subtensor/tree/v477), against finney's V15 metadata fetched at block #9276924 (the last spec 477 block): `Runtime::compose_call` for the call, `Runtime::signature_payload_parts` for the signed extensions, `digest::generate_extrinsic_proof` for the RFC-0078 proof (`ExtraInfo`: spec 477, `node-subtensor`, prefix 42, 9 decimals, `TAO`).
- The payload matches what finney checks: at block #9276924, finney's `TaggedTransactionQueue_validate_transaction` rejects the signed extrinsic with `Payment` (the test account has no funds), and with `BadProof` once one signature bit is flipped, so the runtime accepted the signed spec version, genesis, era and metadata digest.

title: Bittensor TaoBalance amounts are shown as raw integers (add_stake shows "amount_staked 1000000000")
